title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-r05h: .tmp_check/test.rs accidentally committed
description:
Commit 592dfa855 introduces `.tmp_check/test.rs`, a throwaway Rust file with a deliberate compilation error (2-argument transcript_4 called with 3 arguments). This temp check file should not be tracked in version control. The `.tmp_check/` directory is not in `.gitignore`.

Fix: remove the file with `git rm .tmp_check/test.rs` and add `.tmp_check/` to `.gitignore`.
